summary:
Implemented the terminal window title feature, but I did not run the tests or Black, per the instructions. Nothing is committed.

Changes:
- rich/segment.py: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 after ERASE_IN_LINE; added Tuple[ControlType, str] to the ControlCode union.
- rich/control.py: added the formatting-table entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07"; added Control.title(title), which returns cls((ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE, title)), with a docstring.
- rich/_windows_renderer.py: added a dispatch branch that calls term.set_title(title) with the control's second item.
- rich/console.py: added Console.set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor. It buffers the control only when is_terminal is true and returns True or False. The docstring notes Rich cannot restore the title.
- CHANGELOG.md: added an Unreleased "Added" bullet linking pull request 2200.
- Tests: test_set_window_title (tests/test_console.py, skipped on win32), test_control_title (tests/test_control.py), and test_control_set_window_title (tests/test_windows_renderer.py, Windows-only via the module's existing skip).

Choices to review:
- The console test skip uses sys.platform == "win32", since sys was already imported.
- The ControlCode union gained a fourth member rather than modifying an existing one.
- The CHANGELOG link is https://github.com/Textualize/rich/pull/2200. I did not verify that number.
